quote_1: So under the ⟦T1⟧ it ignores rereads that would help it finish
quote_2: Failures below an agent’s ⟦T2⟧ were flagged for audit rather than treated as ordinary misses.
justification: ⟦T1⟧ is a runtime resource ration/cap (a 'ration of three' on file rereads) imposed to constrain agent behavior during a run, whereas ⟦T2⟧ is a per-item difficulty label assigned by annotators before results are seen to predict and triage failures; these are distinct mechanisms with no specific common core beyond generic benchmark evaluation.
